fields.DESCRIPTION: Celebrate tradition and spirituality with this exquisite hand-painted marble cow figurine, crafted by skilled artisans of Rajasthan. Symbolizing purity, abundance, and prosperity, the cow holds a sacred place in Indian culture. Made from premium quality marble, this figurine is adorned with vibrant Meenakari-style floral motifs in red, blue, yellow, and gold accents. Each detail is hand-painted with care, showcasing the rich heritage of Rajasthani craftsmanship.
